scope: Two distinct US Blackwing sedans: twin-turbo V6 compact and supercharged V8 midsize. Existing CTS-V2005 and DTS2006 are not duplicates.

sources.access: August10,2021 US MY2022 launch release read2026-11-17. Distinguishes CT4 twin-turbo3.6 and CT5 supercharged6.2, both standard six-speed manual or optional10AT. Full factory text accessible through web tool.

limits: No mixing standard V-series, ATS-V, CTS-V, or optional10AT. Not the older turbocharged4.2L Blackwing V8. Initial collector markings are not a distinct physics variant.

Mass, dimensions, gearing, tracks, tire sizes, rpm anchors and all other non-fact values are explicit estimates. Manufacturer automatic acceleration figures are not used as manual measurements; runtime performance targets remain estimates.

Generic rear locking coefficient and fixed dampers approximate eLSD and Magnetic Ride only; no proprietary PTM, launch control, no-lift shifting or adaptive damping system is claimed. No optional carbon aero downforce.
Shared RTG-001 graphics by reference. No new original art or accepted independent desktop/touch drives.
